svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.rectangle-polyomino-unit-area-comparison", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Use actual congruent unit tiles, then trace and count the cells in each diagram. The left3by2 rectangle and right L shape each contain six12mm square cells, hence equal864square-mm areas despite different outlines. The L has four cells along its bottom row and three along its left column, sharing one corner cell. Twelve cells are drawn across the two regions, not six across the whole tile. No labels or numerals are visible. This exact cell comparison does not estimate the source curved-region area; physical tracing and learner recognition remain pending.", "geometry_exception": "Swell and ViewPlus share1.4mm segment geometry. Native1.2mm Index dots follow the same logical unit boundaries at4mm pitch; congruent triangles use5.6mm acute-corner guards and identical rotated sampling. Shared boundary dots are deduplicated. This is not exact source worksheet reproduction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots, not Braille. Unit boundaries use4mm pitch; triangle boundaries use5.6mm near-vertex guards for acute corners. Identical geometric transform applies to both triangles. Physical continuity remains pending.
